title: Unified Recovery and Monitoring Program
rule_summary: Massachusetts URAMP is a confidential, voluntary recovery and monitoring program for BHPL-licensed health professionals who seek support for mental health or substance use concerns or are referred by a licensing board. Pharmacy's former PSUD program transitioned to URAMP in December 2024. Admission may support non-disciplinary restrictions or conditions, and a licensing board may dismiss a related pending investigation or complaint; dismissal is not automatic.
exam_relevance: Tests the current recovery pathway and avoids treating voluntary monitoring as either automatic discipline or guaranteed dismissal.
common_confusions: PSUD is not the current pharmacy-specific program; it transitioned to URAMP.
The Board may dismiss a related matter after admission; the statute and guidance do not make dismissal automatic.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
